term: Indian Council for Enviro-Legal Action v. Union of India
hold_reason: review: NVIDIA: Hindi name translation inaccurate: 'भारतीय पर्यावरण विधि कार्य आयोग' misrepresents 'Indian Council for Enviro-Legal Action' (an NGO, not a commission).
